lightingReview: All calls used the actual home-route overview and its original-pixel book clip; no requested new light or exposure boost. The generated sheets retain a dim study. They are generated interpretations, not pixel-identical captures or proof of renderer-level lighting equivalence.
observations: Seven directions can be compared with Chinese short-title and English long-title examples.
Paper-label, lighter-leather and larger-type directions have clear structural differences.
Matte gold, debossing and subtle luminous ink are visually closer under the deliberately dim lighting; the debossed depth and luminous quality are restrained.
Small overview lettering is less reliable than the enlarged examples. The gold overview contains a small extra line; it is not part of the title design or any runtime asset.
OCR was used only as a supplemental observation: oblique text gives low confidence and recognition errors, so its output is not treated as a pass/fail oracle.
Book and room geometry vary slightly in generated illustrations. The approved runtime mesh, mechanics, material and lighting were not modified.
performance: Not measured: no runtime code or assets changed. Existing <=10% gate remains for any future implementation.
